title: Chapter 145: Entering The City
content:
Chapter 145: Entering The City

The Zerg Hydralisks successfully suppressed the defense forces on the city wall. Nearly two hundred thousand Zerg puppies swarmed up and launched a full-scale attack on the city!

From the perspective of the Zerg host in the sky, the Zerg puppies are like countless black ants rushing towards a huge cake!

They scramble! Keep moving forward! The momentum is terrifying!

The original anti-impact obstacles under the city wall were of no use to the Zerg puppies. Wherever the Zerg puppies passed, nothing was left behind!

Facing a charge of the size of the Zerg puppies head-on is like facing a huge oncoming tsunami, leaving no one with the slightest will to resist!

"Boom!"

The Zerg puppy rushing forward hit the tall city wall with a loud noise, and the whole city seemed to tremble!

The charging speed of the Zerg puppies did not slow down, and the puppies rushing up from behind directly stepped on the puppies beside the city wall and climbed up.

Every joint of the Zerg puppy is as sharp as a knife, and can easily penetrate into the masonry of the city wall, and it is as easy as walking on flat ground when stepping on high walls!

The ferocious black figure of the Zerg puppy climbed over the entire tall city wall in one go!

The terrain did not affect the Zerg attack at all. It only took a very short time for a large number of Zerg puppies to easily scale the tall city wall that was like a chasm to others under the firepower of the Zerg Hydralisks!

Climbing the city wall is just the first step, the real battle has just begun!

The Zerg Hydralisks immediately charged with the Zerg Puppies. The city wall has been occupied, and their fire suppression mission has been completed!

Direct spike attacks no longer have a range. Their spikes hit the Zerg puppies, and the Zerg puppies will also be harmed. They can only spray Zerg biological decomposition fluid to provide support for the Zerg puppies fighting in the front.

The Zerg themselves can secrete biological decomposition liquid, so they are highly resistant to this kind of decomposition liquid. The Zerg puppies have little impact on fighting with this liquid stuck to their bodies.

The enemy is different. If they encounter this liquid, they will be killed or injured. All kinds of protective equipment are ineffective against this liquid!

The forces of the evil god camp serving on the inside of the city wall launched several attacks on the Zerg puppies with the "slobber" sprayed by the Zerg Hydralisks. They found that the power of the saliva was too powerful, so they did not dare to charge forward again, but stayed at a distance. Attack with ranged attacks.

Actual combat has proven that the damage caused by throwing stones to the Zerg is very limited. Almost all the troops from the Evil God camp participating in the battle used throwing spears!

Throwing spears intensively at the densely packed Zerg puppies on the city wall, the Zerg puppies also felt the taste of melee troops fighting against long-range troops!

You can only be beaten passively!

The Zerg puppy, with Hydralisk saliva on its body, jumped directly from the city wall into the city, and took the initiative to attack the enemies in the city!

More and more Zerg puppies climbed over the city wall, rushed into the city, and fought with the nearby evil god army.

More and more defenders in the city arrived and used spears to attack the Zerg puppies from a distance. Both sides suffered heavy casualties.

In the Zerg territory, from the beginning of the war, groups of thousands of Zerg puppies began to pour out. They happily ran towards the battlefield, one group after another!

Following the footsteps of the charging Zerg puppies, the Zerg Hydralisk successfully scaled the city wall!

The Zerg Hydralisks occupied the high ground of the city wall and launched a condescending attack on the evil god's army in the city.

A sudden heavy rain fell in the city, and nearly 18,000 hydralisks sprayed "slobber" on the city within range at the same time.

A large ball of Zerg biological decomposition liquid was first sprayed into the air by the Hydralisk. After flying to the target location, it exploded and splashed in all directions. The areas with the Evil God camp's troops nearby seemed to be raining corrosive rain!

The sound of melting and corroding, and the sound of screams are endless!

The Zerg's Hydralisks are like long-range life harvesters. The moment they scale the high city wall, all enemies within their range who do not retreat will be annihilated!

The army of the evil god camp, in its current upward shooting state, is even less able to touch the edge of the Zerg Hydralisks.

Many soldiers of the Evil God believers who were unable to retreat launched a desperate attack on the Zerg puppies rushing down the city wall, hoping to melee with the Zerg puppies and avoid the attack of the Hydralisks.

Unfortunately, the saliva of the Zerg Hydralisks was ineffective against the Zerg puppies. The Evil God believer soldiers who rushed in front of the Zerg puppies received a double blow and quickly turned into light and disappeared!

Not long after, nearly 100,000 Zerg puppies rushed into the city. The Zerg Hydralisks fully occupied the front city wall, condescendingly providing long-range support for the Zerg puppies' attack.

The Zerg one-star host flew to the sky above the Zerg Hydralisks and conducted a detailed scan of the city.

"The attack went too smoothly!"

Wu Qing observed the situation in the city through the vision of the one-star host.

Everything seemed normal. The forces of the Evil God camp participating in the battle included bugbears, long-armed ogres, mountain giants, and various powerful native ethnic armies who had converted to the Evil God.

These troops from the evil god camp were indeed stunned by the Zerg's unexpected new fighting method. They were not equipped with full-body protective armor, and faced the Zerg's hydralisks' sputtering and decomposing attacks, they were at a huge disadvantage!

However, Wu Qing always felt that something was wrong.

"Sacrifice! I didn't see the evil god's sacrifice!"

Through the host in the air, Wu Qing did not find any priests directing operations in the army of the evil god camp, and the army of evil god believers did not receive the blessing of faith from the priests!

"No wonder the gap is so big!"

"The combat power of the evil god's army without the blessing of faith is completely incomparable to that of the Zerg!"

"With the Zerg Hydralisk's curved area killing attack, it makes sense that the Zerg can enter the city so smoothly!"

"But none of the evil god priests appeared, which is very abnormal!"

Wu Qing looked at Wu Cong who was on standby beside him and asked: "Wu Cong, in such a war, the priests of the evil god camp neither bless the evil god army nor come out to command the army to fight. What do you think they are doing?"

Wu Cong thought about it, his face changed slightly, and he quickly replied: "So there are no priests? The evil god army without the blessing of priests will be much weaker in combat power!"

"It is very likely that the evil god sacrifice ceremony can make all the priests leave the army in this situation!"

"The evil god sacrifice that requires so many priests to preside over at the same time will summon a very terrifying evil god gift. We must be careful!"

With Wu Cong's reminder, Wu Qing also thought of the evil god sacrifice.

The evil god camp originally planned to hold the evil god sacrifice ceremony during the camp war. The sacrifices they prepared were Wu Cong and his human wanderers.

This was ruined by Wu Qing, which led to the disastrous defeat of the evil god camp in the camp war.

Now, in order to eliminate the new threat of the Zerg, it is very likely that the evil god camp chose to continue the evil god sacrifice ceremony here.
